changes.title: Honest missing-artifact labels
changes.text: Historical attempts without retained APK evidence are labeled accordingly, without claiming that no temporary APK ever existed.

changes.title: Chronological imported builds
changes.text: Importing older APK history no longer places an older build ahead of a newer failed attempt in the same numbering family.

changes.title: Build-order regression
changes.text: Added a permanent regression check for preserving build-number order while importing missing compiled histories.

changes.title: Rendered highlight screenshot
changes.text: The Android highlight capture now waits for a rendered frame instead of capturing the preceding frame immediately after selection.

changes.title: Verified preparation record
changes.text: Recorded successful TEST72 checks, owner-approved hidden-trap behavior and the corrected visual capture in the report and handoff.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I kept missing-artifact labels precise and corrected imported build ordering. I also tightened the Android screenshot timing for the stair highlight.
